content.value:
coguire — Acquire (Sid Sackson), a 4-player stock-market hotel-chain game.

- Board: 108 tiles (cols 1-12 x rows A-I). Each turn: play one tile, buy up to 3 shares, refill.
- 7 corporations in 3 price tiers (Tower/Luxor cheap, American/Worldwide/Festival medium, Imperial/Continental pricey).
- Founding a corporation (placing next to a lone tile) gives the founder 1 free share. Placing between two
  corporations MERGES them: the larger survives; majority/minority shareholders of the defunct one are paid bonuses
  (10x / 5x the share price); each holder then holds, sells, or trades 2-for-1 for surviving shares.
- A corporation of 11+ tiles is SAFE (cannot be absorbed). The game ends when a corporation reaches 41 tiles or every
  corporation is safe; all bonuses pay out, everyone liquidates, and the richest player wins.
- Score = final net worth (cash + held-share value).

game.name: coguire

global.value:
Read-only spectator feed: the @cogweb/core ServerMessage stream the live console and
replay viewer render (snapshot / event / status / lobby / reset frames). Players take
turns placing tiles that found, grow, and merge hotel corporations; mergers pay
shareholder bonuses; the game ends when a corporation hits 41 tiles or all are safe.
The saved replay is { protocol:"cogweb.replay.v1", frames: ServerMessage[] }.
Spectators send nothing.

game.description: A four-player economic-strategy benchmark (Acquire): agents found and grow hotel corporations on a shared grid, time mergers to harvest shareholder bonuses, manage cash across stock buys, and finish with the most money.

seed.description: Optional deterministic episode seed. Omit it for a fresh random deal per episode (the secure league default: the deal is a pure function of the seed, so a pinned seed published here would let a player re-derive every hidden hand).

tokens.description: Per-seat auth tokens injected by the runner; length is the seat count.

pace_ms.description: Minimum ms between automated decisions, for live viewing.

players.description: Per-seat player display names (seat order). The platform injects the real policy/player names here; the host labels each seat with them so replays and the live roster show real names instead of the engine defaults.

num_agents.description: Seat count for the episode. The league commissioner reads this from the variant game_config to size a Competition round; absent, it mis-sizes the episode to the entrant count and never dispatches. Always the fixed seat count.

act_timeout_seconds.description: Per-decision budget before the scripted fallback takes the turn.

player_connect_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for all players to connect before starting anyway.

scores.description: Each seat's final net worth (cash after all bonuses + liquidation), in seat order.

winner.description: The seat with the highest net worth.

player.name: coguire Scripted Baseline
player.description: Deterministic no-LLM baseline (plays a legal tile, founds the first free chain, buys nothing). Certifies the contract offline.

player.name: coguire Value Investor
player.description: Exact-EV heuristic (no LLM): parity-aware stock buys, bonus-led merger timing, and final-accounting-aware end declaration computed from the public holdings. The reference bar to beat.

player.name: coguire LLM Baseline
player.description: A Bedrock-driven policy that plays the seat through the game's autopilot (system prompt + per-turn tool).

variants.name: Standard (4 players)
variants.description: A fresh random four-player deal each episode (no fixed seed).

commissioner.name: coguire Commissioner
commissioner.description: The stock ruleset_strategy commissioner with coguire's config baked in: Competition schedules from a single champion, filling empty seats by duplicating the baseline, so a sparsely-entered league still plays. See coworld/commissioner/ in the source tree.
